reply.text: One bad night won't tank your strength, but it'll cost you on bar speed, focus, and joints feeling heavier than they should. If you train, drop the intensity — lighter loads, leave more in the tank, and skip anything maxed out or technical where fatigue could screw up your form. Honestly, if you can swap today for an easy or lighter session instead, that's the smarter call. Want me to adjust what's on deck for today?
